    for fn in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(fn,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) or not fn.name.startswith('test_'): continue
        behavior=fn.name[5:].replace('_',' ')
        found=None
        for n in ast.walk(fn):
            if isinstance(n,ast.With):
                for it in n.items:
                    c=it.context_expr
                    if isinstance(c,ast.Call) and isinstance(c.func,ast.Attribute) and c.func.attr in {'raises','warns'} and c.args:

    for n in ast.walk(tree):
        mod=None; imported=[]
        if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom):
            if n.level:
                base=cur[:max(0,len(cur)-(n.level-1))]
                if n.module: base += n.module.split('.')
                mod='.'.join(base)
            else: mod=n.module or ''
            imported=[a.asname or a.name.split('.')[-1] for a in n.names]
        elif isinstance(n,ast.Import):
            for a in n.names:
                if a.name.startswith('astropy.'):
                    cand=a.name.replace('.','/')
                    for q in (cand+'.py',cand+'/__init__.py'):
                        if q in pathset: scored[q]=scored.get(q,0)+text.count(a.asname or a.name.split('.')[-1])

        if not mod or not mod.startswith('astropy'): continue
        cand=mod.replace('.','/')

            if q in pathset or (root/q).exists(): target=q; break
        if target and target"'!=p:
            score=2+sum(text.count(x) for x in imported if x!='"'*')

def clean(s,limit=360):
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s or '').strip()
    s=s.replace('|','/').replace('\\n',' ')
    return s[:limit].strip(' :')

def module_for(p):
    parts=Path(p).parts
    if parts[0]=='cextern':
        if len(parts)>1 and parts[1]=='cfitsio': return 'F'
        if len(parts)>1 and parts[1]=='wcslib': return 'B'
        return 'E'
    if parts[0]"'!='"'astropy': return 'G'
    if len(parts)>1 and parts[1]=='io':
        if len(parts)>2 and parts[2] in IO_MODULES: return IO_MODULES[parts[2]]
        return 'I'
    return MODULES.get(parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else '', 'G')

def layer_for(p):
    path=Path(p); s=p
    if 'tests' in path.parts or path.name.startswith('test_') or path.name=='conftest.py': return 'T'
    if path.suffix.lower() in {'.fits','.gz','.bz2','.xz','.z','.csv','.ecsv','.dat','.hdr','.xml','.xsd','.json','.parquet','.hdf5','.cfg','.tex','.rdb','.tab','.dbout','.list','.eopc04_iau2000'}: return 'D'
    if path.name in {'pyproject.toml','setup.py','tox.ini','MANIFEST.in'} or 'setup_package' in path.name or path.parts[0]=='cextern' and path.suffix in {'.ac','.m4','.in','.guess','.sub','.sh'}: return 'B'
    if path.suffix.lower() in {'.yml','.yaml','.toml','.ini'} or path.name.startswith('.') or path.name in {'codecov.yml'}: return 'X'
    if 'scripts' in path.parts or path.name in {'wcslint.py','hub_script.py'}: return 'E'
    if path.name=='__init__.py': return 'E'
    if path.suffix.lower() in {'.c','.h','.pyx','.l'}: return 'I'
    if any(x in path.name for x in ('connect','registry')): return 'I'
    if module_for(p) in {'W','K'}: return 'U'
    return 'C' if path.name in {'core.py','base.py','table.py','quantity.py','wcs.py','fitting.py','sky_coordinate.py'} else 'S'

def feature_tags(p,text):
    tags=[]
    suf=Path(p).suffix.lower()
    if suf in {'.c','.h','.pyx','.l'}: tags.append('N')
    if any(k in p for k in ('io/','fits','ascii','votable','format','parser','serialize','yaml','hdf5','parquet')): tags.append('F')
    if any(k in text for k in ('Quantity','UnitBase','unit_support')) and module_for(p) not in {'L'}: tags.append('Q')
    if any(k in text for k in ('Masked','mask','masked')) and module_for(p) in {'N','T','U','W','I','Q','F'}: tags.append('M')
    if any(k in text for k in ('register_reader','register_writer','register_identifier','registry')): tags.append('R')
    if module_for(p)=='J' or 'matplotlib' in text: tags.append('V')
    if any(k in text for k in ('download_file','urllib','remote_data','requests.')): tags.append('D')
    if any(k in text for k in ('multiprocessing','ProcessPool','parallel')): tags.append('P')
    if module_for(p)=='P' or any(k in text for k in ('asyncio','xmlrpc','socketserver')): tags.append('A')
    if any(k in text for k in ('ScienceState','ConfigItem','set_temp')): tags.append('S')
    return tags[:3]

def parse_ast(text):
    try: return ast.parse(text)
    except Exception: return None

def doc_sentence(tree):
    if not tree: return ''
    d=ast.get_docstring(tree,clean=False) or ''
    d=re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n|(?<=[."'!?])'"\\s+',d.strip())[0]
    return clean(d,260)

def public_names(tree,text,p):
    if not tree: return []
    names=[]
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)) and not node.name.startswith('_'):
            names.append(node.name)
        elif isinstance(node,ast.Assign):
            for t in node.targets:
                if isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='__all__':
                    try:
                        vals=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
                        if isinstance(vals,(list,tuple)): names=[str(x) for x in vals]
                    except Exception: pass
    if Path(p).name=='__init__.py' and not names:
        for node in tree.body:
            if isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom):
                for a in node.names:
                    n=a.asname or a.name
                    if not n.startswith('_'): names.append(n)
    return list(dict.fromkeys(names))

def words_from_tests(tree):
    vals=[]
    if not tree: return vals
    for n in tree.body:
        if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name.startswith('test_'):
            z=n.name[5:].replace('_',' ')
            for old,new in [('raises','errors'),('invalid','invalid input'),('roundtrip','round trip'),('init','construction')]:
                z=z.replace(old,new)
            vals.append(z)
    return vals

def test_contracts(tree):
    out=[]
    if not tree: return out
    for fn in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(fn,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) or not fn.name.startswith('test_'): continue
        behavior=fn.name[5:].replace('_',' ')
        found=None
        for n in ast.walk(fn):
            if isinstance(n,ast.With):
                for it in n.items:
                    c=it.context_expr
                    if isinstance(c,ast.Call) and isinstance(c.func,ast.Attribute) and c.func.attr in {'raises','warns'} and c.args:
                        typ=ast.unparse(c.args[0]) if hasattr(ast,'unparse') else '指定异常'
                        found=(c.func.attr,typ); break
            if found: break
        if found:
            verb='抛出' if found[0]=='raises' else '发出'
            out.append(f\"{behavior} 时{verb} {found[1]}（{fn.name}）\")
    return out

         'testwords':words_from_tests(tree),'contracts':test_contracts(tree)}
    records[p]=rec

def resolve_imports(p,tree,text):
    if not tree: return []
    cur=list(Path(p).parent.parts)
    scored={}
    for n in ast.walk(tree):
        mod=None; imported=[]
        if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom):
            if n.level:
                base=cur[:max(0,len(cur)-(n.level-1))]
                if n.module: base += n.module.split('.')
                mod='.'.join(base)
            else: mod=n.module or ''
            imported=[a.asname or a.name.split('.')[-1] for a in n.names]
        elif isinstance(n,ast.Import):
            for a in n.names:
                if a.name.startswith('astropy.'):
                    cand=a.name.replace('.','/')
                    for q in (cand+'.py',cand+'/__init__.py'):
                        if q in pathset: scored[q]=scored.get(q,0)+text.count(a.asname or a.name.split('.')[-1])
            continue
        if not mod or not mod.startswith('astropy'): continue
        cand=mod.replace('.','/')
        target=None
        for q in (cand+'.py',cand+'/__init__.py',cand+'.pyx'):
            if q in pathset or (root/q).exists(): target=q; break
        if target and target"'!=p:
            score=2+sum(text.count(x) for x in imported if x!='"'*')
            scored[target]=max(scored.get(target,0),score)
    return [q for q,_ in sorted(scored.items(),key=lambda kv:(-kv[1],kv[0]))[:5]]

def data_role(p,data,text):
    path=Path(p); n=path.name; m=module_for(p); dom=DOMAIN[m]
    suf=path.suffix.lower()
    if suf in {'.fits','.gz','.bz2','.xz','.z','.parquet','.hdf5'}:
        return f'提供{dom}测试或示例使用的二进制/压缩格式夹具 {n}'
    if suf=='.hdr' or 'header' in n:
        return f'提供{dom}测试使用的 FITS/WCS 头文本夹具 {n}'
    if suf in {'.xml','.xsd','.dtd'}:

        return f'提供{dom}解析、数值回归或往返测试使用的数据夹具 {n}'
    if not text:
        return f'提供{dom}测试或构建使用的二进制资源 {n}'
    return f'提供{dom}测试、构建或运行使用的资源数据 {n}'

      'conftest.py':'配置全仓库 pytest 插件、测试选项、隔离环境和共享夹具',
    }
    if p in exact: return exact[p]
    d=rec['doc']
    pubs=rec['public']
    if d:
        base=d.rstrip('.')

        return base
    if pubs: return f'实现{dom}的 {\", \".join(pubs[:8])} 等对象与操作'

def api_for(p,rec):
    path=Path(p)
    if layer_for(p) in {'T','D','X'}: return '-'
    if p=='pyproject.toml':
        names=re.findall(r'(?m)"'^([A-Za-z]['"\\w-]+)\\s*=\\s*\"["'^"]+:[''^"]+"'"',rec['text'])
        return ('命令 '+', '.join(names[:12])) if names else 'Python 包构建与安装元数据'
    if p=='setup.py': return 'setuptools 构建入口'
    if p=='tox.ini': return 'tox 环境命令'
    if path.suffix in {'.h'}:
        names=re.findall(r'(?m)"'^[A-Za-z_]['"\\w\\s\\*]*\\s+([A-Za-z_]\\w*)\\s*\\(["'^;{]*'"\\)\\s*;',rec['text'])
        names=list(dict.fromkeys(names))
        return ', '.join(names[:12]) if names else '-'
    if path.suffix=='.pyx':
        names=re.findall(r'(?m)"'^(?:cpdef|cdef public|def)'"\\s+(?:\\w+\\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\\w*)',rec['text'])
        return ', '.join(dict.fromkeys(names)) if names else '-'
    names=rec['public']
    if not names: return '-'
    return ', '.join(names[:15]) + (f' 等 {len(names)} 项' if len(names)>15 else '')
